feed.subtitle: The official blog of AR Forum - sharing insights, research, and updates on augmented reality technology and applications.

entry.title: Welcome to our blog!
entry.content: Welcome to the our blog! The goal of this blog is to make our research more accessible and to engage with the broader ML community. We believe that understanding why models fail is just as important as making them succeed. Stay tuned!
